name: Hemperly 2025 infliximab pediatric IBD PK/ER scenarios
description: Exact paper anchors and fixed-effect full ODE induction simulations with Figure 4 paper overlays.

scenarios.name: Exact Tables 1-4/text/Figure 4 source anchor
scenarios.description: No-dose exact replay of source scalars from the article tables, Results text, and Figure 4 labels.

scenarios.name: Standard 5 mg/kg induction typical full ODE
scenarios.description: Fixed-effect two-compartment IV ODE using the reported pediatric reference weight and albumin with 5 mg/kg infusions at weeks 0, 2, and 6.

scenarios.name: Low albumin 5 mg/kg induction sensitivity full ODE
scenarios.description: Same nominal regimen with albumin set to the lower Table 1 IQR value to expose the paper's albumin clearance/volume covariate effect.

scenarios.name: Intensified 10 mg/kg induction exploratory full ODE
scenarios.description: Exploratory 10 mg/kg induction regimen; the article notes physician-judgment dosing and accelerated regimens but does not publish a matching source curve.
